description: The perfect complement to your outdoor gear, Rothco’s Camouflage 8 X 21 Binoculars have a long-range field of view and are compact so they can be stored almost anywhere. The outdoor binoculars feature fold-down rubber eyecups so you can comfortably look through without having any irritation. Rothco’s camo binoculars are great for any avid outdoorsman, including hunters, hikers, and campers.
